fr_html: LE PRESIDENT passe au vote d'ensemble. Il procède à l'appel nominal, par ordre alphabétique.
en_html: The PRESIDENT then proceeded to take a vote upon the plan as a whole. He called upon the members by name, in alphabetical order.
